scope: One bounded same-instance Chisel witness forwards C2 endpoint terminals into S2, forms the existing packed-read association terminal only on the final fragment, observes its release, and then admits the matching existing R6 retirement/reclaim transaction.

boundary.terminal_bridge: testbench RouteARTL37bPackedReadTerminalBridge; forwards each endpoint terminal to S2 and emits one association terminal only when last is asserted
boundary.retire_gate: testbench RouteARTL37bReleaseRetireGate; accepts the association release before forwarding only a matching runtime retirement
boundary.r6_r5_owner: existing R6/R5 global drain, durable reclaim, and retire acknowledgement
boundary.unclosed: C2 grants remain verification facts; C1 sidecar and static R4 fixtures remain; C2 R1/R2 status is not added to the R6 global collector

invariants: every exact endpoint terminal is forwarded to S2
only the final endpoint terminal creates one packed-read association terminal
the association terminal uses captured work identity/page/slot/generation/delivery context and endpoint status
association release must be accepted before a matching runtime retirement can reach R6
missing or mismatched identities cannot pass the testbench-only retire gate
ready-low carriers remain stable at work, S2-terminal, association-terminal, release, and gated-retire boundaries
R6/R5 retain global drain, durable reclaim, and retire acknowledgement ownership
no production-top or global-collector topology change

chisel_commands: cd hardware/route_a/chisel && env JAVA_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/java-21-openjdk-amd64 sbt -batch 'testOnly kvpress.routea.rtl2.RouteARTL265eSameInstanceWitnessSpec -- -z "composes real publication"'
cd hardware/route_a/chisel && env JAVA_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/java-21-openjdk-amd64 sbt -batch 'testOnly kvpress.routea.rtl2.RouteARTL265eSameInstanceWitnessSpec -- -z "reads the exact R3-durable"'
evidence_labels: no cycle timing throughput deadlock claim
